notes.title: Developer Livestream 2
notes.content:
[h2]Livestream[/h2]
The Voice Inside is a psychological horror adventure game with different & challenging game control types. Use the voice-control, or a unique controller & keyboard system to give the right commands & move freely through a dark & abstract world. Try To Escape The Darkness!

[b]Let's have fun together, playing with all different control types, like the Voice-control, to explore a dark and atmospheric game world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/a129b0ce9dac7acfa69f1c0c0aa6d29619fb8fbe.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Here is a new update for you!
We are still here, and we put a lot of time and effort into our big update 2020 during the lock down to make a rapid progress. We still need time to make the game ready for Early Access in 2021! But for now, we keep spending a lot of time developing & preparing the game. We will give you some more updates, soon! 😊
Stay tuned & healthy guys! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/1c05e0cbb3dac2c488bb77360d565a3318e494ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Recently Visited Shows & Conferences 2019
notes.content:
We applied for booths and we had the chance to show our game on several shows and conferences this year. We got a lot of helpful feedback on how to improve the game. Thank you guys!
We are currently improving the game with that feedback.

[h1]Shows and Conferences[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Access 2019 (Czech Republic)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/d3b22de91385f769936ad082a863cab8538067c0.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]GameDaily Connect/Casual Connect 2019 (USA)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/5c32721c0b455e18f2da6cb0edc1730d8d72d389.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Tokyo Game Show 2019 (Japan)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/6fc87ea08de27192da66d4b1c0054dfb715f0747.jpg[/img]
[/list]

You can meet us at upcomming events in 2020 and test our game.
For the rest of 2019 we want to focus on the game development and have no plans for other conferences, yet.

- updated command list


[h1]Shop Update[/h1]
- short description
- main description

...

Leave us a comment and tell us if you like the new look of our Steam page. :)
Thx~

notes.content:
[b]Update 2 [/b]

Hey! We worked a lot on the project the last months to improve the game and implemented some of the suggestions from the first testers.

[list]
[*] demo area playable + bug fixes
[*] performance improvement
[*] realized some important suggestions from our dear testers (AMAZE)
[*] new voice commands 
[*] command list now available - command: 'show commands'
